newsitem.title: THAILAND: Research Alert - Accumulate Dhana Siam - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: Research Alert - Accumulate Dhana Siam - Merrill.

text.p: Merrill Lynch and Co said on Thursday investors should accumulate shares of Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc, saying the current weak outlook of the finance sector should not cloud its value.
Merrill Lynch said Dhana Siam's non-performing loans, based on those unserviced for over six months, was only two percent of its total lending at end-1996.
It said the company has set aside accumulated provisions to cover all doubtful as well as 48 percent of its substandard debts, against a 20 percent minimum set by the central bank.
